## New
- **Pick a colour from the screen.** Click the new eyedropper button in the shelf, or choose **Pick Colour from Screen** in the menu-bar menu. Click any pixel and its code, for example `#4C8DF6`, is copied and added to the shelf as a colour clip.
## Install or update
Choose **Check for Updates…** in the Cpaste menu, or download `Cpaste.zip` and replace the app in Applications. Requires macOS 14 or later on an Apple Silicon Mac.

## New
- **New c↗ branding.** Updated app and menu-bar icons, keeping the familiar clip layout. - **Smarter clip colours.** Colours are selected from each source app’s icon palette using the same algorithm for every app, with no app-specific overrides. Headers remain fully opaque. - **More readable labels.** Source colours are toned for readable white text. Category colours stay as chosen, with white or black labels selected for contrast. - **Compare text clips.** Select two text clips with Cmd+click, then press Space or choose Compare from the right-click menu to see their differences side by side. - **Preview from the menu.** Right-click a clip and choose Preview to see it in full. - **Selection and hover feedback.** The selected card glows in its colour, and cards lift slightly under the pointer.
## Install or update
Choose **Check for Updates…** in the Cpaste menu, or download `Cpaste.zip` and replace the app in Applications. Requires macOS 14 or later on an Apple Silicon Mac.

## New
- **Full preview.** Press Space on a clip to see the whole text or the full-size image. Press Space or Esc to close it. - **Private categories.** Right-click a category and make it private. Its clips stay hidden, also from search, until you unlock it with Touch ID or your Mac password. It stays unlocked for one minute. - **Category icons.** Right-click a category to give it an emoji. - **More card types.** Emails, phone numbers, dates, addresses and JSON each get their own card. - **Link titles.** A copied link shows the title of its page when the browser gives one. Nothing is fetched from the internet. - **Most used.** Each card counts how often you used it, and the filter menu can sort by it. - **Status in Settings.** Settings now shows whether recording, pasting, updates and history are working. - **Install with Homebrew.** See the README for the three commands.
